name: PR findings can be counted and filtered by severity
description: From PR #482's Agent runs tab, confirm the per-run SeverityFilterBar renders its three chips, then click WARNING and confirm the selection lands in the URL (?severity=WARNING) and the list narrows to the warning-level finding ('N+1 query in user list endpoint'), leaving the critical one behind. The seeded run holds exactly one CRITICAL ('Hardcoded Stripe secret key in commit') and one WARNING, so the filter's effect is visible as a positive assertion rather than an absence. Exercises SeverityFilterBar / FindingsPanel and the ?severity= round-trip. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
